title: Clean Stateless Kit Stores And Kit Command Requests
description: Implement stateless semio/js stores (KitStore, DesignStore, TypeStore facades) that only track task ids; single typed execute to semio/rs; extend Rust KitStoreHandle.execute so every call allocates a task id and emits lifecycle events; remove setField and any from public JS boundary; update semio/react hooks for taskId; extend existing tests.
summary: Completed stateless KitStore plan: typed KitTypedShellCommand + dispatchKitTypedShellCommand; acquire/release facade per bridge; KitStore.runMutation only (no public patch/add/remove); domain facades (DesignStore, TypeStore, etc.); React kitCommandStore + runKitTypedMutation. executeSemioKitCommand now routes all mutations through acquireSemioKitCommandFacade + runMutation so sketchpad string commands share the same shell path. JS embedded tests + vitest 143 passed; React build/tests verified.
